idea: market-neutral relative crowding among BTC, ETH, SOL (all point-in-time top-10 every month 2022-26): per coin z (90 d, 1-day lag) of a crowding metric, demeaned across the 3 coins; position per coin -0.15 x clip(z_c - mean z, -2, 2) / 2 (long the least crowded, short the most crowded)
use: each enters the pool; the Gen391 forward-stepwise basket selection on 2022-24 is rerun on the enlarged pool
